shots.focal_element: Title text centred inside the right of two large squircle panels on a darker solid background, small Typeform wordmark below
shots.transition_other: none (video start; anchors give no transition_in)
on_screen_text: Add brand assets to your typeforms with Brand Kit
shots.typography: Geometric/grotesk sans, regular weight, sentence case, normal tracking, three centred lines; small bold wordmark below (font guess, low confidence: Typeform's own brand sans)
shots.what_happens: Static title card holds while the VO opens (w0-w6, 'Put your brand front and center with'); in the last half-second both squircle panels begin sliding to the right, starting the exit.
shots.build_rebuild: Render two 2-col squircle panels (large corner radius) on a solid background, centre a 3-line sans headline plus small wordmark in the right panel, hold ~2.7 s, then translate the panel row rightwards with an ease-in to hand off to the next shot.

shots.focal_element: Empty solid background gap between the departing squircle panels, then a light cream panel rising from the bottom
shots.transition_other: Panel row slides horizontally out of frame (push-like), detected as a cut by code
shots.what_happens: The squircle panels continue sliding past (only edges and a sliver of the title's first letters remain visible), leaving the solid background; by 4.0 s a cream panel wipes up from the bottom to cover most of the frame. VO says 'Typeforms Brand' (w7-w8).
shots.build_rebuild: Continue the horizontal panel slide until the background is empty, then animate a full-width cream rectangle upward from the bottom edge (translateY 100% to 0) with an ease-out over ~0.5 s.

shots.focal_element: Typeform welcome screen card ('Thanks for staying at the Tropical Hotel!') centred on cream background
shots.transition_other: Cream panel wipes up from the bottom, then the white form card appears on it (mask/wipe-like reveal)
on_screen_text: Thanks for staying at the Tropical Hotel!
We'd love to hear about your experience!
shots.typography: Form UI in neutral sans: regular-weight sentence-case headline, smaller regular subline, bold white label on a solid button, tiny 'press Enter' hint; 'THG' logo in a bold slab/serif style added top-left
shots.what_happens: Cream background holds briefly, then an unbranded white form card fades/scales in (~5.5 s) and settles slightly larger; a 'THG' logo pops into the top-left corner (~6.5 s, on 'Add your logo', w10-w12), and a small pink rounded square drops in at top-centre at the end (anticipating the colour-palette line, w13).
shots.build_rebuild: Show a centred white rounded card with headline, subline and primary button over a cream backdrop, scale it from ~0.9 to 1 with opacity fade, then pop a logo image into the card's top-left on the VO cue and drop a small coloured rounded square from the top edge as the shot ends.

shots.focal_element: Pink square sweeping across the form headline, restyling the text it covers into a serif font
on_screen_text: Thanks for staying at the Tropical Hotel!
We'd love to hear about your experience!
shots.typography: Same form text; inside the moving pink swatch the headline and subline render in a light serif with a contrasting text colour (a 'theme lens' effect); outside it stays in the original sans
shots.what_happens: Brief (0.76 s) moment: colour swatches (yellow and pink rounded squares, teal edge) drop onto the form; the pink square passes over the headline and subline, revealing a restyled serif/coloured version of the text underneath, as the VO says 'set a color palette' (w13-w16).
shots.build_rebuild: Stack the plain and themed versions of the form text, clip the themed layer to a moving rounded-square mask (pink fill) that travels across the headline, while additional swatch squares drop in from the top with a quick ease-out.

shots.composition_other: Diagonal cascade of three overlapping form cards from top-left to bottom-right
shots.focal_element: Three themed versions of the same form (yellow, pink, teal) cascading diagonally
shots.transition_other: Themed fill expands to replace the white card (in-place restyle / morph-like change)
on_screen_text: Thanks for staying at the Tropical Hotel!
We'd love to hear about your experience!
shots.typography: Each card repeats the same form text (counted once) in a light serif, sentence case; small solid buttons with bold labels; 'THG' logo in bold slab/serif top-left of each card
shots.what_happens: The pink theme fills the form card, which then shrinks and splits into a diagonal cascade of three themed cards (yellow, pink, teal) during 'and create themes that you and others in your organization can apply' (w17-w28); at ~12.5 s the cascade collapses back to the single pink card, which then exits leaving an empty cream frame.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the themed form card down, then animate two duplicates with different theme colours outward along a top-left to bottom-right diagonal (staggered translate with ease-out), hold ~2 s, reverse the stagger into the centre card and fade/scale it out.

shots.focal_element: Typeform workspace dashboard grid of form tiles, with the 'Brand kit Beta' entry in the bottom-left sidebar
shots.transition_other: Screen recording slides/scales in over the cream frame (cream edge visible at 14.0 s)
shots.typography: Native product UI sans at UI sizes: small regular sidebar labels with counts, uppercase small-caps section headers (PRIVATE, SHARED), medium-weight page title, centred regular tile titles; tile footer response counts and sidebar counts omitted from the text list
shots.what_happens: Real screen recording of the Typeform workspace; the frame settles in and holds while the cursor rests in the grid, as the VO finishes 'to Typeforms' and starts 'To add a Brand Kit' (w29-w35), setting up the click on the 'Brand kit' sidebar item.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a full-bleed 1080p screen capture of the dashboard, entering with a short scale/slide from slightly inset to full frame, and hold it static so the next shot can direct attention to the bottom-left 'Brand kit' item.
